chunks: And the Day the Hour comes, on that Day they will be separated into categories.
ai.seo_question: What happens to people on the Day of Resurrection according to Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate reality of *Ma'ad* (Return), where the unity of humanity fractures into distinct factions based on adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt and true faith. It serves as a warning against the *fitnah* (trial) of worldly attachments, emphasizing that the final division is not merely physical but spiritual, reflecting one's alignment with divine truth.
